About this data — sourcing, extraction method & coordinate accuracy

Source

Архівна україніка в Канаді: Довідник (Archival Ukrainica in Canada: Directory). Kyiv, 2010, 882 pages. Compiled by the State Committee of Archives of Ukraine, the Ukrainian Research Institute of Archival Science and Records Management, and the Canadian Institute of Ukrainian Studies, University of Alberta.

Scope

All 56 archival, museum and library institutions whose full address block (Адреса / Тел. / Факс / Веб-сайт) appears in the directory. The book's hundreds of individual fonds and collection entries — personal papers, family collections, organization records — contain no separate home or personal addresses; only institutional repository addresses appear anywhere in the book.

Map

Rendered with D3.js on a Mercator projection, using public province/territory boundaries (click_that_hood Canada GeoJSON). Only the seven provinces with institutions in this dataset are tinted and clickable as filters; the rest are shown muted for context.

Coordinates

Live street-level geocoding services were blocked or rate-limited in the environment this atlas was built in, so positions instead come from an offline Canadian postal-code (FSA) centroid dataset — typically accurate to within 1–5 km of the real building, closer in dense urban postal areas, looser in rural ones. Treat pins as neighbourhood-accurate, not rooftop-accurate. Enderby and District Museum, which has no postal code anywhere in the source, is plotted at the town centre instead.

Known gaps

A few source entries are incomplete in the original book itself — e.g. the Saskatchewan Archives Board's Regina office address omits the street name, and the Legal Archives Society of Alberta's postal code is truncated. These are preserved as found rather than invented; see each entry's own notes.
